title: Disclose the graph snapshot format boundary from the record-id rename
outcome: Disclose the graph snapshot format boundary from the record-id rename
acceptance: A disposable old/new build probe confirms the refusal and documented recovery; required gates and paired review cover the corrected input.
The documented recovery uses the matching old build and explicit full-store export/import without editing fingerprints, reminting ids, or implicitly migrating a live store.
The snapshot and full-store migration briefs explicitly state that the ObjectHash to ObjectId rename changes the runtime snapshot format fingerprint and older snapshot files refuse.

completion.summary: Disclosed the deliberate graph snapshot format boundary and verified the matching-old-build disposable recovery route. Independent acceptance passed all 3 unchanged criteria; corrected-input nine gates and Codex/Claude review passed with no Medium/High/Critical. No live conversion or cutover claimed.
